data_table.description: One table (one sheet) of the PBGC Pension Insurance Data Tables workbook, read as published: header rows joined ("Trusteed Termination Data Claims ($ millions)"), source lines and footnotes in the notes, label rows kept, column sheet_row. The pack reads the index page, finds the edition's Excel link (paths differ by year) and reads the sheet. S- tables are the single-employer program, M- tables the multiemployer program.

year.desc: edition year as listed on the index page (2010-2024 have Excel files; 2024 is the newest, a 1st installment published 2026-08-04); default: the newest edition. The edition year is not the data year: each table states its own years

table.desc: sheet name as published: "S-1" ... "S-49", "M-1" ... "M-21" (also s1, S1, "Table S-1"), or GLANCE (PBGC data at a glance); an installment edition lacks some tables

header_row.desc: optional: 1-based row of the (first) column-name row; default: detected

header_rows.desc: optional: how many header rows to join; default: detected

table_list.description: The tables of one edition from its DATA BOOK LISTING sheet: table, title (with the table's own year range), program (single-employer or multiemployer), section, in_workbook (no = listed but not in this installment).

year.desc: edition year as listed on the index page (2010-2024 have Excel files; 2024 is the newest, a 1st installment published 2026-08-04); default: the newest edition. The edition year is not the data year: each table states its own years

editions.description: The editions with an Excel file on the index page: year, label (with installment and posting date), url, format (xlsx; 2011 xls).
